title: The public brand door answers 503 JSON LANE_UNAVAILABLE when the guest lane is missing, unreachable, silent or answers 502/504 — never a status Cloudflare swaps for its own text/plain 502
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/public.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# fail' line and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: With no guestSiteKey, a throwing lane fetch, a throwing guest-session mint, a lane 502/504 and a lane that never answers, GET /design-inspiration/api/brand/<host> answers 503 application/json {code: 'LANE_UNAVAILABLE'} with the translated message; a lane's own JSON 404 still passes through.

A guest-session mint that never answers is cut off within laneTimeoutMs and answered 503 LANE_UNAVAILABLE (before review fix L2 it hung for good), and a lane answer whose body streams on past laneTimeoutMs is delivered whole (before: the timeout signal errored the body halfway).
evidence: #811 F-S5-001; 11/10/2026 curl https://cowork.tracy.site/design-inspiration/api/brand/example.com → 502 text/plain 'error code: 502' from Cloudflare, while the origin on the dev machine answered 502 application/json LANE_UNAVAILABLE (GUEST_SITE_KEY unset there).
fence: publicRoutes laneFetch in apps/tracy-web/src/public/route.js; no network, no Cloudflare.

tests: the brand door is unavailable, not crashed, with no guestSiteKey configured
the brand door answers 503 JSON, not a crash, when the guest lane cannot be reached
the brand door answers 503 JSON when minting the guest session throws
a lane 502/504 is answered as 503 JSON, never passed through for the edge to replace
a guest lane that never answers is cut off and answered as 503 JSON
a guest session mint that never answers is cut off and answered as 503 JSON
a lane answer whose body streams past the time limit is delivered whole
